name: Tech in Asia

sources.title: TIA help: list a company — login > Jobs menu > 'Create Company'; claim existing profile or 'Add New Company'; success@techinasia.com for problems (content read via search result)
TIA help: pitches to editors@techinasia.com; contributed content via community@techinasia.com with content guidelines; branded content team for paid campaigns (content read via search result)

requirements: Two surfaces: (1) the company database — free, login > Jobs > Create Company, claim an existing profile or 'Add New Company'; (2) editorial coverage — pitches to editors@techinasia.com
Asia focus — the database and editorial cover Asia's tech ecosystem; a non-Asia startup is off-beat
Company profiles are primarily built around the Jobs product — the company profile powers job postings
Contributed articles go to community@techinasia.com subject to content guidelines
Paid branded-content campaigns are a separate product
techinasia.com/submit-startup returned 403 to automated fetch — details verified via the official help center
preparation: Company details for the profile (name, description, logo, jobs context)
Asia relevance — market presence, funding, or operations in Asia
workflow: Create/login to a Tech in Asia account
Go to the Jobs menu > 'Create Company'
If the profile exists, claim it; otherwise 'Add New Company' and fill details
For press coverage, pitch editors@techinasia.com (or individual writers)
For contributed content, submit to community@techinasia.com per guidelines
watchFor: Database listing is free but anchored to the Jobs product — a company profile exists to post jobs
Editorial is Asia-focused; 'get covered' criteria emphasize regional significance
Third-party 'submit startup' guides point to techinasia.com/companies/create — reachable only after login
Subscription content: much of TIA editorial sits behind a paywall
countsAsLive: The company has a public profile in the Tech in Asia database (visible under Companies search)
unknowns: Whether the free company profile requires posting a job to be publicly visible
Current state of the /submit-startup landing flow
